messages:
ashley: hitting an SSL issue with the py async SDK when connecting to our private deployment in the customer's VPC. sync client fine. anyone seen mismatch in CA handling?

emily: what's the exact error and how are you configuring certs?

ashley: `ssl.SSLCertVerificationError: certificate verify failed: unable to get local issuer certificate` from httpx. I set SSL_CERT_FILE and REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE in the container but async still fails.

kevin: brief background: sync client exposes ca_bundle and falls back to env vars; async path currently builds its own ssl.SSLContext using certifi and ignores env in some codepaths. we missed parity here.

ashley: repro snippet: `from redwood import AsyncClient; AsyncClient(api_key="x", base_url="https://redwood.private")` there is no ca_bundle kwarg.

emily: two fixes: (1) add ca_bundle param to AsyncClient and forward to httpx via verify or SSLContext, (2) ensure env var fallbacks (SSL_CERT_FILE/REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE) are respected. also update typing so mypy accepts the param.

kevin: agree. also, retry behavior: current transport retry layer retries on transport errors which causes noisy retries for SSL verification failures. propose default retry_on_ssl = false so certificate problems surface immediately.

ci-bot: created issue #5077: "py-sdk: async ca_bundle + env fallback + disable ssl retries" linking this thread.

ashley: workaround for customers: use raw httpx.AsyncClient with verify path or set up a small wrapper until sdk patch lands. example: `httpx.AsyncClient(verify=\"/etc/pki/custom-ca.pem\")`.

emily: will add a short Dedicated quickstart blurb showing env and systemd/k8s examples and a tiny mypy test. kevin, can you draft the PR?

kevin: on it. will include unit tests for explicit ca precedence, env fallback, and a retry test ensuring SSLCertVerificationError is non-retriable by default. ping here when ready for review.

ashley: thanks 44d that should unblock our rollout.
